summary: [probe] Common English dated decision notes are missed: 'The cap was approved on 2026-10-01.' (passive with a non-'it' subject), 'Per the Oct 21 decision, the cap is 3.' ('decision' followed by ','), 'As agreed with legal on 2026-10-01, the cap is 3.', 'Approved by the PM on Oct 21.' draw nothing; only 'decided on', 'decision on/of' and we/team/operator/they/owner/it-was subjects count.
